items.title: CorelDRAW now has an AI tool that designers might actually use
items.excerpt: CorelDRAW's September update adds Text-to-Vector AI, generating editable vector illustrations from prompts rather than flat raster output.

items.title: Viral AI animation sparks controversy over familiar character design
items.excerpt: A viral AI-generated animation draws backlash for a character design that closely echoes an existing IP, reopening the originality debate around generative art.

items.title: How we save entry-level UX work that teaches craft in the time of AI
items.excerpt: Patrick Neeman argues that AI now does the transcript tagging, theming and clipping juniors used to learn on, and proposes seven tasks UX teams should keep for humans to build the design bench for 2030.

items.title: Regulating AI, Quantifying stress, The variance problem
items.excerpt: UX Collective's weekly roundup argues AI governance should be treated like a living product iterated by design teams, not a one-shot waterfall bill.

items.title: OpenAI’s AI agents need to catch up
items.excerpt: A rumored new ‘Aeon’ platform could be entering a crowded market of 24/7 assistants.

items.title: Even AI can't perfectly assemble Ikea furniture—yet
items.excerpt: Epoch AI researchers use Ikea assembly instructions as a benchmark for spatial reasoning, showing frontier models still stumble on reading visual product instructions.

items.title: How a character from 'The Addams Family' is shaping the future of robotics
items.excerpt: ETH Zurich's Soft Robotics Lab designed a self-contained robotic hand that crawls, balances and manipulates objects on its own, a modular approach to physical-AI product design.

items.title: Claude Sonnet 5.5 now available on AI Gateway
items.excerpt: Access Claude Sonnet 5.5 through Vercel AI Gateway with the AI SDK, compatible APIs, or coding agents for coding, clearer writing, and polished documents.

items.title: AtomCut made its own intro using Opus 5.5 ( Launch Motion design )
items.excerpt: AtomCut shows a launch motion-design intro built entirely by Claude Opus 5.5 driving its AtomCut MCP, an example of agent-generated motion graphics.

items.title: UserTesting’s MCP Servers: AI Product Teams Need Human Insight Inside the Loop
items.excerpt: UserTesting launched Model Context Protocol servers on Sept 25, turning human research insight into a tool call AI product and design teams can pull into agent workflows.

items.title: Rendering Complex AI Reasoning States in a React Dashboard
items.excerpt: A UI pattern walkthrough for surfacing an AI agent's live reasoning states in a dashboard so human operators can follow what it is doing.

items.title: Synopsys introduces AgentEngineer solutions for engineering
items.excerpt: The solutions run on the Autopilot Platform, with more than 50 engagements underway and general availability planned for late 2026.

items.title: New Google Flow build now points to Nano Banana 2.1
items.excerpt: A new Google Flow web build labels an upcoming image model as Nano Banana 2.1, replacing an earlier 2.5 Flash reference; Google has not announced it yet.

items.title: Humanoid robots are getting even creepier (this one can cry on command) - Engadget
items.excerpt: Humanoid robots such as the Yansyn-X2 are being designed to mimic human emotion, including crying on command, raising uncanny-valley questions for robot product design.

items.title: Researchers plug GPT-6 Astra directly into a robot and let it clean up an unfamiliar kitchen
items.excerpt: Stanford and Caltech's HomeBody system lets GPT-6 Astra call modular robot skills directly, and a humanoid independently tidied an unfamiliar kitchen without a trained control layer.
